evals.name: HTTP Security Headers & Helmet Hardening
evals.prompt: Configure HTTP security headers using Helmet for an enterprise backend API, ensuring Content-Security-Policy, HSTS (1 year), X-Frame-Options: DENY, and nosniff are enforced.
evals.expected_output: Configures Helmet middleware with strict CSP, HSTS with preload, frameguard DENY, and nosniff.
assertions: Configures Content-Security-Policy with strict default-src 'self' directive
Sets X-Frame-Options to DENY to eliminate clickjacking iframe attacks
Sets X-Content-Type-Options to nosniff to prevent MIME-type confusion exploits

evals.name: CORS Whitelist Lockdown & Zero Credentialed Wildcards
evals.prompt: Implement a CORS middleware that enforces an explicit whitelist of allowed frontend origins, supports cookies with credentials: true, and caches preflight responses for 10 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Constructs CORS validator using explicit origin whitelist and forbids wildcard origin with credentials: true.
assertions: Enforces explicit origin validation against a whitelist of trusted production domains
Strictly forbids wildcard origin (*) when credentials: true is enabled
Restricts allowed HTTP methods to standard REST operations
Configures preflight maxAge caching to 600 seconds to minimize preflight round-trips

evals.name: Multi-Tier Rate Limiting Matrix & Inbound Payload Limits
evals.prompt: Configure rate limiting and body parser limits for an Express application, enforcing 5 req/min on login, 1000 req/min on authenticated routes, and a 1MB ceiling on JSON request bodies.
evals.expected_output: Configures differentiated rate limit tiers and caps JSON request body parsing at 1MB to prevent DoS.
assertions: Enforces strict rate limiting on auth login (5 requests per minute per IP)
Enforces differentiated higher throughput for authenticated API users (e.g. 1000 req/min)
Enforces 1MB limit on JSON request body parsing to mitigate memory exhaustion DoS
Returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when rate limits are exceeded
